meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把关分析检测方法是否经得起验证审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要给实验室检测方法准备验证和证明材料。
copy.tagline_en: Prove your lab method is reliable for its intended use before release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must show an analytical method is fit for its intended purpose under regulations.

howto.what: Claude 会按 ICH Q2(R2) 等法规框架规划并记录分析方法验证/转移:生成方案草稿,检查线性、精密度、检测限、批次合规或方法等效性,输出报告,但不替你下是否合格的结论。
howto.when: 当你想验证/确认/转移某个分析方法,或问它是否合用,或提到“method validation”“linearity”“detection limit”等关键词时。

say.text: 按 ICH Q2(R2) 帮我规划一个 HPLC 含量测定法的验证方案。
say.note: 会生成方案草稿,空出接受标准由你填。

say.text: 检查这批校准数据,看线性是否成立,再算 LOD 和 LOQ。
say.note: 会判断数据点是否偏离直线,并给出 LOD/LOQ 值。

say.text: 按 ICH M10 评估这个 LC-MS/MS 批次是否合规。
say.note: 会按色谱或配体结合法的标准逐项检查。

howto.what_en: Claude plans/documents analytical method validation/transfer under frameworks like ICH Q2(R2); drafts protocols; checks linearity, precision, detection limits, run compliance or equivalence; reports findings without a verdict.
howto.when_en: When you want to validate/verify/transfer an analytical method, ask whether it is fit for use, or mention triggers such as 'method validation', 'linearity', 'detection limit'.

say_en.text: Plan an HPLC assay validation protocol under ICH Q2(R2).
say_en.note: It will draft the protocol but leave criteria for you.

say_en.text: Check this calibration data: is the response linear? Also find LOD and LOQ.
say_en.note: It flags deviations from linearity and estimates LOD/LOQ.

say_en.text: Assess this LC-MS/MS batch against ICH M10.
say_en.note: It will check QC rules by modality.
